past_draft_plan_for_rebuilding_formal_up.highlights:
Wraparound stitch detail: Large visible stitches follow the upper and sole edge, giving this low-top sneaker a distinctive casual profile.

Textured microfiber upper: Layered panels and a stitched toe section create visual depth without relying on a plain one-piece vamp.

Lace-up front with hook detail: Rope-style laces pass through loops and upper hooks, making the closure a clear part of the design. A heel loop sits behind the low collar.

Rubber outsole: The actual bottom photograph shows an oval-pattern tread and a sculpted sidewall.

Five colour options: Black, White, Khaki, Light Brown and Red Brown, with EU38-47 options. Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
past_draft_plan_for_rebuilding_formal_up.dedup: Exact source URL/model absent from registry; metal-hook lace system, wraparound stitch-through-looking edge and sculpted rubber sidewall differ from HR024 leather/mesh PVC sneaker and from HR030 canvas platform. No wide fit or hiking performance claim.
